audit: erun inputs upload --dry-run <TMP> <HOME>/.erun/outputs/evidence.bin
inputs: uploading <TMP> (5 bytes) to <HOME>/.erun/outputs/evidence.bin
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec -i deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -c '<remote-script>'
inputs upload script:
  set -e
  dir='<HOME>/.erun/outputs'
  name='evidence.bin'
  mkdir -p "$dir" 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ ! -d "$dir" ] || [ ! -w "$dir" ]; then cat >/dev/null; echo "erun-inputs: destination directory is not writable: $dir" >&2; exit 3; fi
  tmp="$dir/.$name.erun-upload-tmp"
  cat > "$tmp"
  mv "$tmp" "$dir/$name"
  size=$(stat -c %s "$dir/$name" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  sha=$(sha256sum "$dir/$name" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$size" "$sha"
